description: A draft LEAN algorithm based on the inferred concept of 'style herding by mutual funds'. Due to unavailable paper text, this implementation uses A-share specific settings and a placeholder technical signal (RSI) to simulate the strategy structure.
risk_controls: Trailing Stop: Liquidate if price drops 5% from highest price since entry
Max Drawdown: Liquidate and stop trading if portfolio value drops 15% from peak
Position Sizing: Limits investment to 95% of available cash
Lot Size: Rounds orders to nearest 100 shares (A-share requirement)
blocked_reason: data_coverage=0.0% < 20% threshold (>80% missing from tushare/open sources)
